name: EXM_TRAVEL_DATA_VAL_ERR_TYPES
description: This table contains information about the validation error types that occurred for an itinerary, reservation or reservation item during the Travel Itinerary Import and Validation process.

columns.name: TRAVEL_DATA_VAL_ERROR_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of validation error type for itinerary, reservation or reservation_item.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: ERROR_TYPE
columns.description: Resulting validation error type such as CRITICAL, MISSING_VALUE, INVALID_FORMAT or UNMATCHABLE.

columns.name: CONFIRMATION_NUM
columns.description: Confirmation number of reservation.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_CODE
columns.description: Travel itinerary validation rule applied that resulted in error.

columns.name: VALIDATION_RULE_SET_ID
columns.description: Itinerary validation rule set that resulted in error.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: TRAVEL_INTEGRATION_ID
columns.description: Travel partner integration from which the itinerary was imported from.

columns.name: BOOKING_SITE_ID
columns.description: Booking site for which this itinerary was booked.

columns.name: TRAVEL_ITINERARY_ID
columns.description: Travel itinerary that resulted in validation error.

columns.name: ITINERARY_RESERVATION_ID
columns.description: Reservation in travel itinerary that resulted in validation error.

columns.name: RESERVATION_ITEM_ID
columns.description: Reservation item in travel itinerary that resulted in validaton error.

columns.name: ITINERARY_IMPORT_DATE
columns.description: Date when this itinerary was imported.
